note: Set A includes claims from Figure 2-11 (planform/centers) but misidentifies the blade planform boundaries as structural centers (geometric and shear), resulting in factually incorrect 'misbound' claims. Set B omits Figure 2-11 data entirely (missing important facts) but avoids these falsehoods. Both sets contain internal contradictions on Figure 2-10 values (e.g., multiple stiffness values for the same condition), but Set B includes some underestimates (1.2e11 vs 1.5e11) while Set A's Figure 2-10 readings are slightly more accurate. Set B is preferred as hallucinating structural properties (Set A) is more severe than omission or reading variance.
remarks: Both sets exhibit instability by extracting multiple contradictory values for the same data point (e.g., mass density 3000 vs 3100, torsional stiffness 0.9e11 vs 1.0e11). Set A's errors on Figure 2-11 are category errors (confusing envelope with axis), whereas Set B's errors are numerical reading errors.
